summary: Production-quality code. YAML workflow is correct (pinned versions, minimal permissions, proper dependencies). PowerShell scripts follow best practices throughout: Set-StrictMode, $ErrorActionPreference='Stop', parameter validation, proper try/catch, meaningful errors, clean module exports. Excellent modularity (parsing/aggregation/reporting separated). Minor: complex logic like flaky detection (TestResultsAggregator.psm1:97-102) and test case setup (run-act-tests.ps1:147-158) could benefit from inline comments explaining the approach.
